answer:
The simulation is performed in OpenFOAM using the reactingParcelFoam solver with Lagrangian particle tracking for liquid dodecane spray combustion in hot air.
The computational domain is a 2D axisymmetric cylindrical chamber with length 0.2 m and radius 0.05 m (diameter 0.1 m), representing the r-z plane of a full cylinder.
The mesh is generated with blockMesh as a structured 100 cells in the axial direction by 50 cells in the radial direction, with grading refined near the axis (r=0) and near the injector face at the inlet.
The axis boundary (r=0) uses an axis-type boundary condition.
The wall boundary (r=0.05 m) uses noSlip for velocity, fixedValue T=400 K for temperature, zeroGradient for species mass fractions, and standard wall functions for k and epsilon.
The inlet boundary (axial left face, x=0) uses fixedValue U=(10 0 0) m/s, fixedValue T=800 K, fixedValue p=101325 Pa, fixedValue species mass fractions O2=0.233 and N2=0.767 with all others zero, and fixedValue for k and epsilon computed from 5% turbulence intensity at 10 m/s.
The outlet boundary (axial right face, x=0.2 m) uses totalPressure at 101325 Pa for pressure, and zeroGradient for U, T, all species, k, and epsilon.
The initial field throughout the domain is quiescent air at rest: U=0, T=800 K, p=101325 Pa, O2=0.233, N2=0.767, all product species zero, k=0, epsilon=0.
The turbulence model is standard k-epsilon, set as RASModel kEpsilon in constant/RASProperties.
The combustion model is EBU (Eddy Break-Up), set as combustionModel EBU in constant/combustionProperties, so that the k-epsilon turbulence field directly modulates the reaction rate.
The chemical reaction mechanism is a two-step global scheme for dodecane oxidation defined in constant/reactionSchemes: Step 1 is C12H26 + 6.5 O2 -> 12 CO + 13 H2O, and Step 2 is 12 CO + 6 O2 -> 12 CO2.
The species set in constant/reactionSchemes and thermophysicalProperties is nC12H26, O2, CO2, H2O, CO, and N2 (inert).
Thermodynamics uses janafThermo, set in the thermoType entry of constant/thermophysicalProperties.
The liquid dodecane spray is injected using the cone injection model in constant/sprayCloudProperties, located at the axis center on the inlet plane (r=0, x=0).
The spray injection parameters in sprayCloudProperties are: total mass flow rate 0.002 kg/s, initial droplet temperature 300 K, Rosin-Rammler size distribution with mean diameter 50e-6 m, standard drag model, and Ranz-Marshall heat and mass transfer model.
The solver configuration files to set up are: system/blockMeshDict for the mesh, 0/ directory fields for all boundary and initial conditions, constant/RASProperties for k-epsilon, constant/combustionProperties for EBU, constant/reactionSchemes for the two-step mechanism, constant/thermophysicalProperties for janaf thermo and species, constant/sprayCloudProperties for the Lagrangian cloud, and system/fvSchemes and system/fvSolution for discretization and linear solvers.
